_note: External facts/estimates, separate from user data. Each has a 'type': FACT | ASSUMPTION | ESTIMATE | PROJECTION. Verify FACT/pending items before relying on them for real decisions -- see reports/research_notes.md.

index_fund_equity.note: historical long-term nominal CAGR often cited ~11-13%; NOT guaranteed, future may differ materially

home_loan.note: Loanable cost = land+construction only; registration/legal/interiors/contingency assumed paid in cash, not financed.

stamp_duty_registration_pct_tn.note: Tamil Nadu: stamp duty ~7% + registration ~4% typical combined figure; verify current rates

house_cost_scenarios.note: Per-sqft land rates for Chennai outskirts corridors (Sriperumbudur/Oragadam/Thirumazhisai/Guduvanchery/Tambaram outskirts) are placeholders pending live research; construction rate is a generic TN standard-quality independent-house estimate.

allocation_policy_default.note: Default policy, user-overridable. Emergency fully prioritized until target met; bike gets a dynamically recomputed required-monthly reserve; remainder splits by weights shown. On bike completion, its reserved monthly amount redirects to house fund.

tax_new_regime_fy2025_26.note: New tax regime is default in India from FY2023-24 onward; slabs revised in Budget 2025 with nil tax up to Rs 12L taxable income (plus standard deduction for salaried) via rebate u/s 87A. Verify exact slab breakpoints and rebate mechanics before relying on this for tax filing.
